title: Validate native client sources and extend measured usage reports
goal: Discover actual supported client/provider usage sources and preserve missing coverage while extending provenance-aware cost and batch guidance
acceptance: Assess Codex/ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Qwen instruction loading and authorized metadata usage sources; label unsupported/inaccessible sources explicitly
Implement only selected source adapters with neutral fixtures for canonical counters, per-request delta IDs, retries and phase boundaries; no transcript scraping
Add optional currency/price provenance and separate observed spend from remaining estimates when actual source evidence supports them; unknown values remain unavailable
Provide optional batch-planning advice without changing priority, dependencies, authority, human acceptance or budget permissions
Keep shared usage unallocated until explicit conserving allocation is available; no duplicated provider totals or inferred activity split
privacy: Only authorized counter metadata and deliberately supplied neutral exports; no credentials, prompt/body logging or global client configuration changes without applicable authorization.
validation: Neutral native-source fixtures establish supported field semantics and missing coverage
Actual client loading/source availability reported separately from static bridge/tool checks
escalation: A client without exposed usage cannot acquire measured counters from a rule; keep unknown
A ChatGPT subscription meter is not inferred API money spend
No consumer adoption gates this repository release
